info.title: TailTrace Aircraft Identity, History & Intelligence API
info.description: Evidence-first aircraft intelligence for autonomous agents. Resolve physical-aircraft identity, inspect registration history, and retrieve available regulatory, safety, maintenance, operator, capacity, and registered-base evidence with provenance, confidence, freshness, conflicts, and uncertainty preserved.

get.description: Resolve an FAA N-number to available evidence-backed physical-aircraft identity and registration information. Provenance, confidence, freshness, and uncertainty remain explicit.
Return available registration and historical evidence for an FAA N-number, including unresolved tail history, identity conflicts, provenance, and source freshness where present.

Return the fuller available evidence-based aircraft view, which can include registration history, safety, maintenance, regulatory, operator, capacity, and registered-base context. Availability remains source- and evidence-scoped; unsupported facts are not inferred.

PaymentRequired.description: x402 V2 payment required; accepts Solana mainnet USDC through PayAI

HealthResponse.description: Gateway health status; it does not describe aircraft evidence.

network.description: Solana network used by the gateway.

ReadinessResponse.description: Gateway readiness status; it does not establish aircraft or source coverage.

network.description: Solana network used by the gateway.

AircraftIdentity.description: Physical-aircraft identity when sufficiently resolved. A missing or null field is unresolved evidence, not a negative finding.

manufacturer.description: Manufacturer represented by the identity evidence.

model.description: Model represented by the identity evidence.

series.description: Series or variant when supplied by the source.

serial_number.description: Manufacturer serial number when linked to this physical aircraft.

year_manufactured.description: Year of manufacture when supplied by the source.

faa_aircraft_code.description: FAA aircraft reference code when supplied.

ProvenanceItem.description: Source attribution for a returned evidence item. Provenance identifies the source record; it does not by itself prove current validity or commercial output permission.

dataset.description: Source dataset represented by the item.

source_file.description: Customer-safe source artifact name when permitted; internal paths are not disclosed.

raw_hash.description: Hash of the source record or raw artifact when supplied.

SourceFreshness.description: Per-source currency and coverage metadata. A freshness state describes the represented snapshot; it is not a claim that the source has just been refreshed.

source_url.description: Source reference when commercial output permits it.

source_snapshot_date.description: Date of the source snapshot represented by this evidence.

retrieved_at.description: When TailTrace retrieved the source snapshot, when available.

tailtrace_processed_at.description: When TailTrace processed the snapshot, when available.

last_successful_refresh_at.description: Latest successful refresh metadata when available; absence does not prove source unavailability.

freshness_state.description: Source currency state such as CURRENT, STALE, PARTIAL, or SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE.

coverage_state.description: Coverage state for this source, which may be partial, ambiguous, conflicting, or unavailable.

commercial_output_allowed.description: Whether this source-level detail is permitted in the relevant commercial output.

EvidenceRecord.description: Source-specific aircraft evidence item. Fields vary by endpoint and source; common fields expose traceability, confidence, dates, validity, and uncertainty without implying that an absent field is a negative finding.

provenance.description: Source attribution for this evidence item, when supplied.

source.description: Source label when supplied directly on the item.

source_record_id.description: Source-record identifier when supplied directly on the item.

confidence.description: Source or identity confidence label; it is not a probability or valuation score.

resolution_status.description: Identity resolution state associated with the item, such as MATCHED_STRONG, MATCHED_CORROBORATED, AMBIGUOUS, or NEEDS_IDENTITY.

evidence_status.description: Evidence availability or disposition state when supplied.

valid_from.description: Start of the represented validity period when supplied.

valid_to.description: End of the represented validity period when supplied.

reason.description: Reason for a conflict, unresolved link, or evidence limitation when supplied.

Pagination.description: Endpoint-specific pagination metadata. Pagination describes returned evidence windows and does not change identity confidence.

offset.description: Zero-based offset used for the returned window.

limit.description: Maximum page size requested or applied.

returned_count.description: Number of evidence items returned in the window.

has_more.description: Whether more evidence may be available in a later page.

IdentifyResponse.description: Evidence-backed aircraft identity response. Resolution status, provenance, source freshness, and uncertainty must be interpreted separately.

requested_n_number.description: Normalized registration requested by the caller.

resolution_status.description: Physical-aircraft resolution state; this is identity confidence/status, not source currency.

identity.description: Resolved physical-aircraft identity when supported; null or absent means identity remains unresolved.

registration_evidence.description: Registration evidence items returned for the request; each item is source-specific and must be read with its provenance and confidence fields.

provenance.description: Source attribution records for evidence returned by the endpoint.

source_freshness.description: Per-source snapshot currency and coverage metadata; stale or partial states require current verification.

HistoryResponse.description: Registration-history response preserving linked history, unresolved tail history, identity conflicts, provenance, confidence, and source freshness.

requested_n_number.description: Normalized registration requested by the caller.

identify.description: Identity evidence used as the resolution context for the history response.

registration_evidence.description: Registration-history evidence items; dates and identity links remain source-scoped.

ntsb_events.description: NTSB event evidence linked by the service; an empty array is not confirmation that no event exists.

aids_events.description: FAA AIDS event evidence linked by the service; an empty array is not confirmation that no event exists.

unresolved_tail_history.description: Historical registration evidence not sufficiently linked to the resolved physical aircraft; do not attach it without corroboration.

identity_conflicts.description: Conflicting identity assertions or linkage evidence that remains unresolved.

provenance.description: Source attribution records for the history response.

source_freshness.description: Per-source snapshot currency and coverage metadata for the history response.

IntelligenceResponse.description: Broader aircraft intelligence response. Availability is source- and evidence-scoped; unsupported ownership, title, valuation, or accident-free conclusions are not inferred.

requested_n_number.description: Normalized registration requested by the caller.

identify.description: Identity evidence used as the resolution context for the intelligence response.

registration_evidence.description: Registration evidence items linked or returned for the request.

ntsb_events.description: NTSB event evidence when returned; absence is not a negative finding.

aids_events.description: FAA AIDS event evidence when returned; absence is not a negative finding.

sdr_events.description: Service difficulty evidence when returned; absence is not a negative finding.

regulatory_records.description: Regulatory evidence records when returned; applicability and currency remain source-scoped.

operator.description: Operator-related evidence when returned; it is not an ownership or title determination.

passenger_capacity.description: Capacity evidence when returned; it is not a claim about installed configuration unless the source says so.

registered_base.description: Registered-base evidence when returned; it is not an operational-homebase or last-known-location claim.

provenance.description: Source attribution records for intelligence evidence.

source_freshness.description: Per-source snapshot currency and coverage metadata; stale, partial, or unavailable states require current verification.
